effect:
A Ball for Pokémon caught before.

Repeat Ball has a 3.5x catch rate multiplier on species you've already registered as caught in your Pokédex. First-time catches get no bonus.

Perfect for catching duplicates - whether you need another one for breeding, trading, or just want a better nature or ability. If you're shiny hunting a species you've already caught, Repeat Balls are your friend.
